spec_defects.description: POST /v1.1/email/verify/batch declares type string, but provider cURL/Python examples send a JSON array of email objects. The node sends that documented array.
POST /v1/toxicity/list declares type string, but its schema example and generated request examples are JSON arrays of email strings. The node sends that documented array.

GET /v1/toxicity/list/{id}/data declares an object response while the published example is an array. The harness cannot validate the documented array and generates {}; the node correctly accepts the documented array, covered by its native mock tests.

The 200 response example is a 400 error envelope, while 202 documents an empty JSON object. The catalog uses the published empty-object witness; node rejects the error envelope and accepts the documented 202 acknowledgment.
